description: This file defines multiple interfaces related to 'grain' components in an Orleans-based system, including consumer grain interfaces, producer grain interfaces, and a fruit interface, primarily used for testing purposes in the project.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Asynchronous method for stopping consumption activities.

methods.name: GetCountOfOnAddFuncCalled
methods.description: Returns the count of how many times the 'OnAdd' function was called.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns the total number of items consumed.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Configures the grain to become a stream producer with specified stream ID, namespace, and provider.

methods.name: StartPeriodicProducing
methods.description: Starts periodic production of items, optionally with a specified firing period.

methods.name: GetNumberProduced
methods.description: Returns the number of items produced.

methods.name: ClearNumberProduced
methods.description: Resets the production count to zero.

methods.name: Produce
methods.description: Triggers the production of a single item.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the number associated with the fruit object.
